text:
alex.support: Heads up — trial account "BrightCart" is hitting onboarding friction: embed quality lower than expected + intermittent SSO 401. They're on day 9 of a 14-day trial, customer sentiment slipping. Need a warm handoff to CS + enablement ASAP. Attaching logs and a screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/brightcart/error-ssolog.png

maria.cs: On it. Can you paste the log excerpts and list of customer contacts? I can set a short enablement session tomorrow. @jenna.ae pls join for renewal context.

alex.support: Logs below (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sso/token -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
Response: {"status":401, "error":"invalid_audience"}
```
Also see vector mismatch after reindex — embedding dims 1024 vs expected 1536. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/brightcart/embed-dim.png
Contacts: Rachel (Dev Lead) rachel@brightcart.com, Tom (PM) tom@brightcart.com

jenna.ae: I can do the customer intro. Do we want a hands-on enablement (screen share + prompt examples) or just a troubleshooting session?

maria.cs: Plan = start with a 30m enablement walkthrough (best-practices for embeddings + prompt shaping) to get quick wins. If SSO 401 persists, escalate to eng triage. Owner: maria.cs for customer comms and follow-up. Success criteria: embeddings replicate expected similarity and SSO auth succeeds for at least 2 requests.

sam.cs_ops: Added BRIGHT-14 to CS risk tracker: https://redwood-internal/trackers/BRIGHT-14. Trial end date set to 1712524800 (unix). Reminder set for 48h before trial end.

liam.eng: Typical cause for invalid_audience is a mismatched client_id/audience in the token. If you can share the sanitized auth header and the app config, we can triage. I'll standby for logs and can join call if needed.

alex.support: Posted sanitized header and minimal repro steps in support ticket. Repro steps: 1) Start SSO flow 2) Exchange code with our token endpoint 3) Call /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embedding-1536 -> receives dim=1024 output. Could be they indexed embeddings with older model.

maria.cs: Final comms plan: 1) Enablement call Wed 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent to customer + jenna.ae) 2) Collect reproduction artifacts during call, escalate to eng if SSO still failing (liam.eng) 3) Post-call async summary with actions and expected timelines 4) AE check-in for renewal positioning 48h after call. I'll capture qualitative feedback and a short NPS prompt if we resolve. @cs_bot please set follow-up reminders.

cs_bot: Reminder created — BRIGHT-14 enablement call Wed 10:00 PT; follow-up task due in 48 hours.

jenna.ae: :thumbsup: I'll take renewal language and next-step email after the call. Thanks team.

alex.support: Marking this as P1 and adding label "trial-risk". Will update support ticket with call notes after enablement.
